criteria.statement: No dependency appears in the package manifest that no checklist obligation required; the client framework, the API framework, the database driver and the mail client are the whole tree.
No table, column or seeded row exists beyond the entities the data model enumerates.
No scheduler, message queue, cache or background worker was introduced for work no obligation asked for.
The source holds no outbound client for the weighbridge, the control system, the laboratory or the customer reporting system, since all four only send inward.
No in-memory substitute for a table, no fixture file standing in for a seeded row and no log sink standing in for the mail service exists anywhere in the tree.
The ledger invariant is expressed once and every write path reaches it there, rather than each route restating the same check.
One shared helper floors every derived integer, so no module rounds a figure another module floors.
One naming convention runs across the source for the same idea, so a consumption is not a consumption in one module and a usage in another.
Unit suffixes are carried consistently in identifiers across every layer, so a mass always ends in _g, a proportion in _bp and a carbon figure in _mg_per_kg.
The arithmetic that derives every claim lives in its own module that the operational-record layer never imports, so the one-way dependency direction the brief states is visible in the tree itself.
The pinned seed values are read from one seed definition wherever they are needed rather than duplicated as literals across modules.
